text:
incident-bot: SEV2: large drop in invoiceable token counts observed across multiple shards (observed at 1835009900). Auto-pager triggered.

oncall_robert: on it. Paging SRE + Finance. I’ll take incident lead.

sre_ana: joining — pulling metering pipeline logs now. Any reports from CS?

cs_maya: already have 4 tickets — customers seeing 0 usage in the dashboard and $0 invoice previews for March.

finance_jay: urgent: pause any automatic invoice finalization if possible. Who runs the invoice job? @eng-nick?

eng-nick: invoice pipeline is a k8s batch job that pulls from metering-cache at 00:10 UTC. I’m checking cache writes and recent infra events.

sre_ana: quick map: collector -> kafka -> metering-agg -> redis-cache -> invoice-service. Aggregator consumed events but redis set operations erroring starting ~1835009587.

oncall_robert: opening sevrunbook SEV_MET_01 (Billing: missing/zeroed usage). Follow steps 1-4.

sre_ana: running log grep:
```
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=metering-agg --since=2h | grep "redis.*ECONNRESET" | wc -l
```
Found ~2100 redis write errors around 1835009587.

ops_tara: infra events show a redis reshard/rolling restart on redis-cluster-04 at 1835009550. Health probes flapped.

eng-nick: autoscaler bumped memory/instances which triggered reshard. During slot migration many metering-agg writes received MOVED/ASK responses. Our write path lacked retries for MOVED.

oncall_robert: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause autoscaler change, 2) requeue unprocessed metering events, 3) deploy retry-on-MOVED in metering-agg, 4) mark affected customers on status page and pause invoice finalization.

product_lead_emma: need a short status page blurb + customer email template. CS needs copy within 15m.

cs_maya: rough customer note drafted — will send to Legal for review.

oncall_robert: operational tasks I’m running now:
- disable autoscaler change
- increase retry budget for metering-agg
- trigger requeue of failed events

eng-nick: running these commands and watching progress:
```
# pause autoscaler modifications
kubectl -n infra scale deploy autoscaler --replicas=0

# requeue events since incident start
python tools/requeue_metering.py --start-ts 1835009500 --dry-run=false
```

sre_ana: requeue started. error rate for redis writes decreasing.

incident-bot: draft status posted to staging: status.redwood.com/incidents (private). Suggested copy below.

product_lead_emma: STATUS PAGE DRAFT — please review and shorten if needed:
"We are investigating an issue affecting usage display and invoice previews for a subset of customers. Some dashboards may show zero usage and invoice previews may appear incorrect. We identified a Redis cluster resharding as the root cause and are restoring cached metering data. Invoice finalization for affected accounts has been paused while we reconcile usage. We will provide an update within 1 hour."

cs_maya: suggest adding: "No customer token data has been lost — this is a caching/display issue. We will correct any billing errors." Customers will panic if we don’t clarify.

legal-bot: do not promise specific refunds. Wording: "we will correct any billing errors" is acceptable.

product_lead_emma: updated the draft accordingly and queued for publish.

cs_maya: customer email template (short):

"Hi <CustomerName>,

We’ve detected an issue affecting usage display and invoice previews. Your dashboard may temporarily show zero usage and invoice previews may be incorrect. We have paused invoice finalization for impacted accounts — if you see an incorrect preview it will not be charged. We are reconciling your usage and will follow up within 24 hours with corrected invoices if needed.

If you have urgent questions reply to this thread and we’ll prioritize.

— Redwood Support"

eng-nick: deployed a canary patch to metering-agg to retry on MOVED/ASK with exponential backoff. Canary logs look good.

sre_ana: redis cluster reported healthy again at 1835010300. Cache write errors dropped to near-zero.

oncall_robert: requeue finished at 1835010500. Total reprocessed events: 2285. Starting reconciliation between raw events and aggregated cache counts now.

eng-nick: sample SQL used for reconciliation:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS raw_tokens
FROM raw_metering_events
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-03-14' AND event_ts < '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

finance_jay: once reconciliation CSV is ready we will run ledger_resync with invoice holds for impacted customers:
```
python tools/ledger_reconcile.py --input reconciled_counts.csv --apply-hold
```

cs_maya: sending first notification wave to impacted customers (47 accounts). Template posted to #templates and linked here.

customer-zen: (external) Thanks. Can you confirm we will not be billed incorrectly? We rely on previews for month-end planning.

cs_maya: replied: "We have paused final invoice sends for impacted accounts and will correct any billing errors. We will notify you before any charge is applied."

eng-nick: reconciliation shows parity for ~98% of accounts after requeue. 52 customers remain with >5% delta — flagged for manual review.

oncall_robert: action items (owners/ETAs):
- eng-nick: finish reconciliation CSV and upload (ETA 20m)
- finance_jay: apply holds and prepare manual invoice overrides for flagged accounts (ETA 40m)
- cs_maya: continue customer notifications and collect replies (ongoing)
- product_lead_emma: publish status page update at next checkpoint (15m)
- sre_ana: monitor for regressions until patch is GA

eng-nick: uploaded reconciliation CSV to secure share at 1835011800: /secure-share/reconciliations/1835009900.csv

finance_jay: running ledger reconcile job at 1835012100 to apply holds for flagged accounts. Will produce sample manual invoice for CS approval before any send.

cs_maya: sending wave 2 notifications — ~120 accounts notified. Added FAQ blurb: "You will not be charged incorrectly; if adjustments are needed we’ll send corrected invoices within 72 hours."

ops_tara: taking over monitoring at 1835012000 (handoff). Handoff note: redis healthy, metering-agg patched to handle MOVED, requeue complete, 52 customers flagged for manual review. Monitoring window: 60m.

ops_tara: ack and monitoring. Will escalate to SEV1 if new regressions or invoice sends proceed unexpectedly.

incident-bot: timeline artifact attached for internal review: /artifacts/1835009900/timeline.log

oncall_robert: closing notes: please keep this thread updated with any customer escalations. I’ll close when ops_tara confirms 2h stable or when all manual reviews are cleared.

ops_tara: 1835013600 — confirming 2h stable window complete, all queued events processed, finance holds applied to flagged invoices. Proceeding to close incident and kick off postmortem: /playbooks/postmortems/1835009900-metering-cache-reshard.md :thumbsup:
